protocol.admission: Five valid trials, 2 or 3 strict successes and core-business evidence review; structural and empirical labels retained separately.

E112.reason: Five fresh trials yield3/5 strict and5/5 public, with54/60 core cases. Both failed trials have evidenced core search-complexity failures within the fixed normal domain: r1 recursively enumerates joint full path histories; r3 enumerates independent routes and their Cartesian products. Their original formal timeouts are retained, never replayed. On the same9–12 inputs a trusted conflict-based reference solves in0.0002–0.0003 seconds at2CPU/3072MiB; the independent pretest multicommodity MILP agrees. The last instance has1,276,007,040 unpruned independent complete-route combinations for four people. No mathematical error is claimed for small cases; medium is conditional on the frozen algorithm-execution budget, not a universal hardness claim. No peripheral boundary, file-contract or import failure supports this label.
